responsibility: Defines the main GCC OS configuration for standard VxWorks targets. It sets VxWorks identification macros, driver initialization hooks, sysroot header search and mode-dependent include specs, startup/endfile/library/linker policy for kernel versus RTP builds, target option override hooks, constructor/destructor handling, size and ptrdiff ABI types, libc capability assumptions, preprocessor builtins for VxWorks personality and mode, cache-flush and DWARF defaults, and LTO/linker policy adjustments. This is the central macro/spec header for normal VxWorks ports, distinct from the common base in vx-common.h and the AE-specific variant in vxworksae.h.
same_name_distinction: This is the central VxWorks configuration header, defining macros, specs, builtins, ABI defaults, and hook bindings for kernel vs RTP behavior; unlike gcc/config/vxworks.cc it does not contain the helper function bodies, and unlike gcc/config/vxworks.opt it is not merely option metadata.
